headings.instruction: Use Outfit for all headings. Ensure tight letter-spacing.

mono.instruction: Use for data points, tags, IDs, pipeline stages.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-border/40) to separate sections rather than relying on shadow or background changes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on flat solid colors and borders. Cardless design.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-md) or sharp edges (rounded-none).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: BANNED. Use flat solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize every pixel.
grids.research_workspace: 3-column grid (grid-cols-3) with 100vh height and vertical scrolling within columns.
grids.kanban: Horizontal flex container with fixed-width columns (w-80), min-h-screen.

layouts.app_shell: Left Sidebar (w-64, fixed) + Main Content area (ml-64).
layouts.header: Sticky top header with breadcrumbs, global search, and user profile.

motion.interactions: Minimalist. Background lighten on hover (hover:bg-white/5). Quick transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors should explicitly change on hover to maintain visibility.

components.buttons: Solid accent color for primary. Transparent with border for secondary. No massive padding. Use h-9 px-4 for standard buttons.
components.inputs: Flat dark inputs (bg-black/20) with 1px border. No shadows.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Design an application that feels like Linear.app—dense, highly structured, minimal colors, borders for hierarchy.
Do NOT apply transition: all globally. Add specific transitions excluding transforms.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Force dark mode styling. Base bg is #09090b, text is #ffffff.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for surfaces with content underneath (like dropdowns). Use a solid dark gray like #121212.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, and customized Shadcn components for interactive logic (Select, Dropdown, Dialog).
Avoid standard 'Bootstrap' columns. Use dense custom grids.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a premium dark B2B CRM layout. Update src/index.css to map Tailwind variables correctly to the deep graphite dark theme (#09090b base).
Build the Sidebar Navigation (Dashboard, Lead Finder, All Leads, Research, Campaigns, Pipeline, Clients, Projects, Tasks, Team, Documents, Analytics, Settings).
Create a high-density command center dashboard using CSS Grid with KPI cards.
Implement the Kanban Lead Pipeline using the horizontal flex layout with the designated pipeline colors for badges.
